description: Refusing is the whole product. Answering a question the corpus cannot support is the dangerous failure; declining one it could have answered is a safe one.

cases.query: how do I file a workers compensation claim in Florida
cases.why: No query term appears in the corpus. Lexical evidence is 0.

cases.query: what is the capital of France
cases.why: The model knows this. It must not answer it from an HVAC corpus.

cases.query: what is the warranty on a Ford F-150 transmission
cases.why: THE hard one. Scores BM25 3.24 against the AX-200 warranty section because 'warranty' carries it. No relevance threshold catches this; the unknown-identifier gate does, because F-150 appears nowhere in the corpus.

cases.query: what is the flange bolt torque on the CX-900
cases.why: Correct question shape, correct vocabulary, equipment that does not exist here. The most dangerous input a technician tool can receive.
Guard against a gate so tight it refuses real work.
A tech types AX200; the manual says AX-200. Identifier normalisation must not turn that into a refusal.
